agent.name: Approval-gated module agent
agent.job: Prepare a tenant-scoped external action and execute it only after a named human approves the persisted action.
non_goals: Execute an external write before approval
Use vendor-local state as the source of truth

workflow.rationale: A human approval must survive process loss and guard an externally visible action.

external_read_check.failure_condition: A fresh process cannot query a tenant-scoped action record without a harness SDK.

record_check.failure_condition: A dependency-shaped outage starts a workflow or produces failed instead of offline.

enforcement_check.failure_condition: The agent invokes the model after its recorded per-run spend cap.

check.failure_condition: The fixture reports an extra model call after resume, a duplicate external action, or missing durable state.
Any required portable behavior predicate fails.

check.command: run harness kill-test with a fresh process and persisted run id
check.failure_condition: A fresh process repeats model selection, cannot resume, or emits a duplicate external action.

conformance.note: This is a proposed agent; the existing bake-off fixture is analogous evidence, not proof for this module.

check.failure_condition: perform_external_action occurs without a preceding persisted approval event.

conformance.note: Requires an adapter event normalizer before it can be automated.
